title: DialKit
notes: Saved for its dependency-free native <dialog> approach — noted as lighter-weight than Radix Dialog for cases that don't need the full feature surface.
summary: A small, dependency-free dialog/modal toolkit built on the native <dialog> element. Handles focus trapping, backdrop dismissal, and stacking without pulling in a full component library.
surfaces_when: the feature needs a modal, dialog, or overlay
the project wants to avoid a full headless-UI dependency for a single dialog
an existing dialog implementation is hand-rolled and accumulating bugs
ambient_line: DialKit — native <dialog>-based modals, no dependency weight.
